en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned main street in a European town, lined with 3–4 story historic townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and roadway. German shop signs are visible on the façades, including a large painted advertisement on the side of a building. The architecture features gabled roofs and stucco fronts typical of Central European towns.
